best_idea: Resolve a row's attached behaviour in layers, type first, then row id, then single instance, where a later detach removes what an earlier layer attached, so a designer can change one spawn without copying the row.
decision_why: Zone and template defaults by row type, then per template, then per spawn, with a spawn-level detach, fits zones as data; the script text format and the Lua sandbox are rejected because rows are the authoring format and behaviour is a row field, not code.
acceptance: A zone test gives every wolf in a pack a patrol default from the type layer, detaches it on one wolf row, and asserts that wolf resolves with no patrol while the rest keep it, identical after a reload.
